metaDescription: Order custom glass gift sets bundles for corporate gifting. Perfect for awards, drinkware, and more. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Glass gift sets and bundles offer a premium, sophisticated look that plastic or fabric alternatives can't match. Whether you're recognizing employee milestones with engraved awards like the Wave Award or assembling custom drinkware sets with 16 oz pint glasses, glass provides a clear, elegant canvas for your logo. Ideal for corporate gifts, client appreciation, or safety program incentives, these sets convey quality and attention to detail. Decoration options include etching, screen printing, and full-color digital printing for a polished finish.
heroAltText: Custom glass gift sets bundles featuring engraved glass awards, pint glasses, and shot glasses for corporate gifting
